about.en: ACNon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Accenture plc Class A shares (NYSE: ACN), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is backed by ACN shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xAbA9Ae731Aad63335C604E5f6E6A5db2e05f549d, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
